integrity: All mathematical coefficients and orbit sizes follow from stated constructive algebraic arguments. Self-review only; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Classifies F_q-linear associative derivations of full matrix algebras, not Lie derivations or arbitrary additive maps. No general claim for matrix algebras over every imperfect field. Finite verifications test bounded sizes, whereas the symbolic argument proves all n and q.
title: Complete rank census of idempotent derivations of full matrix algebras
